summary.text: Tammy Caputi is a Democratic candidate for the Arizona House of Representatives, District 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner and president, she served on the Scottsdale City Council from 2021 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Caputi earned a bachelor's degree from Wellesley College in 1990 and a graduate degree from Simmons University in 1999.
In a Ballotpedia survey she said she owns and operates a business in the construction industry.
She was an at-large member of the Scottsdale City Council from January 12, 2021, to January 14, 2025; she was an incumbent defeated in the November 2024 council election.
Caputi advanced from the Democratic primary on July 21, 2026, with 48.3 percent of the vote.

In the survey, she listed protecting Arizona's water, investing in education and keeping communities safe as her key campaign messages, and named commerce and small business as the policy area she is most passionate about.
